description.en: First gunpla kit

description.ja: 『機動戦士Ｖガンダム』より、試作型ＭＳ「シャッコー」が、
description.en: From "Mobile Suit V Gundam ", the prototype MS " Shakko"

description.ja: RE/100シリーズでガンプラ初キット化。特徴的なプロポーション＆ディテールを新規造形パーツを用いて立体化。
description.en: Gunpla's first kit in the RE/100 series. Characteristic proportions and details are three-dimensionalized using new modeling parts.

description.ja: 各種武装ギミックや成形色によるカラーパターンを再現。
description.en: Reproduce the color patterns of various armed gimmicks and molding colors.

description.ja: ●　シャッコーの機体形状を完全新規造形で立体化
description.en: ● Shakko's body shape is now three-dimensional with completely new modeling.

description.ja: 劇中序盤で活躍した「シャッコー」を、完全新規造形で立体化。
description.en: "Shakko", who was active in the early stages of the play, has been made into a three-dimensional figure with a completely new model.

description.ja: 独特なプロポーション＆ディテールをＲＥ/100フォーマットで徹底再現。
description.en: Unique proportions and details are thoroughly reproduced in RE/100 format.

description.ja: ●　特徴的な各種ディテール＆ギミックを再現
description.en: ● Reproduce various characteristic details and gimmicks

description.ja: 頭部カメラアイの形態変化や右肩に内蔵された２連ショルダービーム・ガンの展開など、特徴的なディテール＆ギミックを追求。
description.en: We pursue distinctive details and gimmicks such as the change in the shape of the camera eye on the head and the deployment of the double shoulder beam gun built into the right shoulder.

description.ja: さらに手首パーツは「ＭＧ Ｖガンダム Ｖｅｒ．Ｋａ」等と同じ規格のサイズで、武装の流用にも対応。
description.en: Furthermore, the wrist parts are the same standard size as "MG V Gundam Ver.Ka", so it can also be used for weapons.

description.ja: カメラアイ
description.en: camera eye

description.ja: 頭部カメラアイは劇中の開閉状態をパーツ差し替えで再現可能。
description.en: The opening and closing state of the head camera eye in the play can be reproduced by replacing parts.

description.ja: ２連ショルダービーム・ガン
description.en: Double shoulder beam gun

description.ja: 右肩の２連ショルダービーム・ガンは、カバー部および基部が可動して展開。設定通りのフレキシブルなアクションが可能。
description.en: The double shoulder beam gun on the right shoulder can be expanded by moving the cover and base. Flexible actions are possible according to settings.

description.ja: ●　ビーム・ローターをはじめ各種武装が付属
description.en: ● Various weapons including beam rotor are included.

description.ja: シャッコーが携行したビーム・ライフル、ビーム・サーベルなど各種武装が付属。
description.en: Various weapons such as the beam rifle and beam saber carried by Shako are included.

description.ja: ビーム・ローターのエフェクト部はPET素材で再現。
description.en: The effect part of the beam rotor is reproduced with PET material.

description.ja: ビーム・ライフル
description.en: beam rifle

description.ja: サイト部が可動し、展開ギミックを再現。
description.en: The site part moves and reproduces the deployment gimmick.

description.ja: ビーム・サーベル
description.en: beam saber

description.ja: 脚部に装備するビーム・サーベルは着脱可能。
description.en: The beam sabers attached to the legs are removable.

description.ja: ●　広域な可動範囲を実現
description.en: ● Achieves a wide range of motion

description.ja: 広範囲の可動域で、流麗なポージングに対応。劇中の活躍シーンを想起させる各種アクションイメージ再現が楽しめる。
description.en: A wide range of motion allows for elegant poses. You can enjoy recreating various action images that evoke scenes from the movie.

description.ja: 付属武装：ビーム・ライフル　／　ビーム・サーベル ／ ビーム・ローター
description.en: Attached weapons: Beam rifle / Beam saber / Beam rotor
